entities.summary: Oriol Junqueras i Vies is a Catalan politician and historian from Spain. A former mayor of the municipality of Sant Vicenç dels Horts in Catalonia, Junqueras served as Vice President of Catalonia from January 2016 to October 2017, when he was removed from office following the Catalan declaration of independence and was imprisoned until June 2021 for his role in organizing the 2017 Catalan independence referendum. He is president of the Republican Left of Catalonia (ERC). Oriol Junqueras was a writers & intellectuals from Sant Andreu de Palomar (b. 1969-04-11, Sant Andreu de Palomar). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
